categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Kangpeng Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the fine chemicals sector, focusing on two main segments: new materials and CDMO (Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization) services. The new materials segment includes display materials, new energy battery materials, electronic chemicals, and organosilicon materials. The CDMO segment covers pharmaceutical and pesticide chemical products, including custom development of active pharmaceutical ingredients and intermediates.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in fluorine-containing fine chemicals, leveraging core technologies such as fluorination and carbon-carbon bond coupling. Key proprietary technologies include the synthesis of lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide (LiFSI) for lithium battery electrolytes, one-pot synthesis methods for supercapacitor electrolytes, and advanced purification and isomerization techniques for liquid crystal monomers. Production methods emphasize continuous fluorination processes, catalyst development, and environmentally friendly, cost-effective manufacturing with low waste emissions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Kangpeng Technology serves customers in electronics (LCD display manufacturers, electronic packaging), new energy (lithium-ion battery producers), pharmaceuticals (innovative drug manufacturers), and agriculture (pesticide producers). Major customers include international industry leaders such as JNC (Japan), Merck (Germany), Merck Sharp & Dohme, Eli Lilly, Bayer Pharmaceuticals, and Bayer Crop Science. The company’s products are used in liquid crystal displays, lithium-ion batteries, electronic circuit boards, medical health, and crop protection sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and multiple production bases in Shanghai, Zhejiang (Quzhou), and Gansu (Lanzhou). It also has a wholly-owned subsidiary in the United States (API, Inc.). Sales are divided between domestic (China) and international markets, with overseas sales accounting for a significant portion of revenue. The company is expanding its international market presence while maintaining strong domestic market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kangpeng Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the chemical supply chain, focusing on the research, development, production, and sale of fine chemical intermediates and specialty materials. It supplies critical raw materials and intermediates to downstream manufacturers in electronics, pharmaceuticals, and agriculture. The company also provides CDMO services, engaging in custom synthesis and manufacturing for pharmaceutical and pesticide clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in fluorine chemistry and advanced synthesis technologies, with significant R&D investment (8.87% of revenue in 2023). Strategic R&D focuses include improving production efficiency and cost reduction for LiFSI, developing high-performance liquid crystal monomers, OLED materials, and organosilicon adhesives. Kangpeng also emphasizes expanding its CDMO pipeline with new drug intermediates and agrochemical products, aiming for international market expansion and dual-track growth in new materials and CDMO services.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct product sales of new materials and CDMO services. The company operates a direct sales model, supplying customized chemical products and intermediates to industrial customers. Revenue streams include sales of specialty chemicals for electronics, energy storage, pharmaceuticals, and agriculture, as well as contract manufacturing and development fees from pharmaceutical and pesticide clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Kangpeng Technology is positioned as a leading domestic player in fluorine-containing fine chemicals and specialty materials, competing with international giants like JNC and Merck in display materials, and with established CDMO providers in pharmaceuticals and agrochemicals. The company has achieved significant market share domestically, especially in LiFSI production and organosilicon adhesives, with ongoing efforts to enhance competitiveness through technology and capacity expansion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Kangpeng Technology reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 979.6 million, a 20.89% decrease from 2022, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 112.7 million, down 37.58%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 3.3 billion, with net assets of RMB 2.77 billion, reflecting growth due to its 2023 IPO on the Shanghai STAR Market. Despite revenue decline due to market conditions, the company maintains positive cash flow and continues investing in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kangpeng Technology emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities, proprietary fluorination and coupling technologies, and high-quality, stable product supply as key differentiators. Its products offer high purity, performance, and cost advantages, enabling import substitution in certain segments like organosilicon adhesives. The company’s integrated quality control system and long-term partnerships with global industry leaders underpin its competitive edge, supporting customized solutions and reliable delivery in high-tech and regulated markets.
